context: Interviewing an athlete before the tournament
purpose: Interview an athlete; teach ワールドカップ/前半/プレー/発揮/速度/レース/抵抗/タイム

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ワールドカップ出場、おめでとうございます！
lines.en: Congrats on making the World Cup!
lines.style: bright interviewer opening warmly, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとう。前半で流れを作りたいです。
lines.en: Thanks. I want to set the tempo in the first half.
lines.style: focused athlete stating his aim, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 自分のプレーに自信はありますか？
lines.en: Are you confident in your play?
lines.style: interviewer probing his mindset, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、練習の成果を発揮します。
lines.en: Yes, I’ll show the results of my training.
lines.style: determined athlete vowing readiness, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: interviewer pressing on a strength, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ、レースでも鍛えてきました。
lines.en: Yes, I trained through races too.
lines.style: athlete grounding it in experience, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 相手の抵抗にはどう対応を？
lines.en: How will you handle opponents’ resistance?
lines.style: interviewer asking tactically, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 冷静に、タイムを意識して戦います。
lines.en: Calmly, mindful of the clock, I’ll compete.
lines.style: composed athlete projecting poise, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
